name: Certified Internet of Things Security Practitioner (ITS-110)

logistics.format: Multiple Choice / Multiple Response, Pearson VUE in-person or OnVUE online proctored

recommended_certs.rationale: IEC 62443 (ISA) と組み合わせて、コンシューマ IoT と産業 IoT の双方をカバーする。

minus.note: IoT credential market is fragmented; ISA/GIAC variants better recognized in industrial settings.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Vendor-neutral IoT protection supports an associate domain baseline useful to manufacturing, while open entry, knowledge-only testing and fragmented recognition prevent a professional industrial-security inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The role-aligned, vendor-neutral IoT security scope supports associate domain knowledge. Open entry, multiple-choice assessment and limited independent recognition keep the signal below professional industrial response capability.

alex-novak.rationale: The vendor-neutral IoT practitioner scope supports a focused technical-domain credential. Open entry, multiple-choice assessment and limited outside recognition prevent a stronger delivery-level judgment.
